name: io.github.cyanheads/cisa-cybersecurity-mcp-server
description: CISA KEV with BOD 26-04 deadlines, SSVC prioritization, and the ICS advisory corpus (CSAF). Keyless.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: CISA_KEV_REFRESH_CRON
environmentVariables.description: Cron expression for the KEV catalog conditional-refresh poll, on every transport. Set off to disable it; an invalid expression fails startup.

environmentVariables.name: CISA_CSAF_MIRROR_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Filesystem path to the local SQLite index of ICS advisories. Unset, it is csaf.sqlite3 under cisa-cybersecurity-mcp-server in the per-user cache directory: ~/Library/Caches on macOS, $XDG_CACHE_HOME or ~/.cache on Linux, %LOCALAPPDATA% on Windows.

environmentVariables.name: CISA_CSAF_MIRROR_AUTO_INIT
environmentVariables.description: Seed the ICS advisory index in the background at startup when it has never completed a sync, and re-ingest it in place when an older server version built it. Accepts true or false; set false where seeding runs out of band.

environmentVariables.name: CISA_CSAF_REFRESH_CRON
environmentVariables.description: Cron expression for the incremental ICS advisory refresh, on every transport; the refresh also runs once at startup. Set off to disable both; an invalid expression fails startup.

environmentVariables.name: CISA_VULNRICHMENT_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds a fetched SSVC record stays cached. Negative results use one sixth of this value.

environmentVariables.name: CISA_FEED_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds a parsed RSS feed window stays cached.

environmentVariables.name: CISA_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for every upstream fetch.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Authentication mode to use: 'none', 'jwt', or 'oauth'.
